---
name: requirements-analysis
description: Extract, clarify, validate, and trace business requirements from Confluence stories into requirements.md.
---

# Requirements Analysis Skill
1. Retrieve source pages with the configured Atlassian MCP tools and verify titles/links.
2. Extract actors, goals, preconditions, success/alternate/error flows, business rules, validation, security, NFRs, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
3. Detect ambiguity, contradiction, missing states, untestable criteria, and unapproved assumptions.
4. Ask the human focused clarification questions before finalizing affected requirements.
5. Use a traceability table: requirement/story ID → source → acceptance criteria → downstream component/test.
6. Mark unresolved decisions as OPEN and do not use them as implementation facts.
7. Preserve source content and distinguish human-approved decisions from recommendations.
8. Verify that each source page was read and report any inaccessible source.
